B.</ls> .²5 To be suitable, be fit for, be adequate for, fit, suit (with <ab>loc.</ab>); क्लैब्यं मा स्म गमः पार्थ नैतत्त्वय्युपपद्यते <ls>Bg. 2. 3</ls>, <ls n="Bg.">18. 7</ls>; उपपद्यते it is fit; ते गुणाः परस्मिन् ब्रह्मण्युपपद्यन्ते <ls>Ś. Br.</ls> --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To bring into any state, cause to arrive or be obtained; विश्वासमुपपादिता <ls>Rām.</ls> inspired with confidence; get ready; रथमुपपादय <ls>Ve. 2</ls>. .²2 To offer, present any one with (<ab>acc.</ab>), bring to; दिष्टपा त्वमसि मे धात्रा भीतेनेवोपपादितः <ls>R. 15. 18</ls>, <ls n="R.">14. 8</ls>, <ls n="R.">16. 32</ls>; <ls>Ms. 9. 72</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 9.">73</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">3. 96</ls>; sometimes with <ab>dat.</ab>; सर्वस्वं वेदविदुषे ब्राह्मणायोपपादयेत् <ls>Ms. 11. 76</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">9. 244</ls>; or with <ab>loc.</ab>; अक्षयोऽयं निधी राज्ञां यद्विप्रेषूपपादितम् <ls>Y. 1. 315</ls>. .²3 .³({%a%}) To cause to happen or occur, bring about; मरणमुपपादयेत् <ls>K. 36</ls>. .³({%b%}) To accomplish, effect, cause, do, perform; यावत्तु मानुष्यके शक्यमुपपादयितुम् <ls>K. 62</ls>, <ls n="K.">113</ls>, <ls n="K.">120</ls>, <ls n="K.">134</ls>; देवकार्यम् <ls>R. 11. 91</ls>, <ls n="R.">17. 55</ls>; <ls>Me. 29</ls>. .²4 .³({%a%}) To make a statement, adduce, put forward. .³({%b%}) To justify. .²5 To make good, establish, prove; कथमीश्वरं विनाशधर्मिणमुपपादयसि <ls>Prab.</ls> .²6 To pronounce, declare. .²7 To make fit or adequate for; कालोपपादिते क्षेत्रे <ls>Ms. 9. 36</ls>. .²8 To furnish with, endow with; <ls>Kām. 11. 57</ls>; <ls>K. 2</ls>; आत्मानं प्रथमं राजा विनयेनोपपादयेत् <ls>Subhāṣ.</ls> .²9 To find out, ascertain; दक्षिणाप्रवणं चैव प्रयत्नेनोपपादयेत् <ls>Ms. 3. 206</ls>. .²10 To examine.
